description: This file implements a decoder for the D-Bus protocol, providing functions to parse and decode various data types from a binary stream according to D-Bus signature specifications.

classes.name: decoder
classes.description: A struct that reads and decodes data from an io.Reader according to D-Bus signature types.

classes.name: stringConverter
classes.description: A helper struct to convert byte slices to strings with reduced memory allocations.

methods.name: newDecoder
methods.description: Creates a new decoder instance with specified input reader, byte order, and file descriptor list.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder to read from a new io.Reader with specified byte order and file descriptors.

methods.name: align
methods.description: Aligns the current read position to the specified byte boundary.

methods.name: binread
methods.description: Reads binary data into a variable, panics on error.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes data from the input stream based on a D-Bus signature string, returning a slice of decoded values.

methods.name: read2buf
methods.description: Reads exactly n bytes into the decoder's buffer, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: decodeU
methods.description: Decodes a uint32 value from the input stream, considering byte order.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a value based on a signature string and current depth, handling various D-Bus types.

methods.name: sigByteSize
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes of a fixed-size signature, returns 0 if variable size.
